allow_instructions: Allow read-only verification: tsc --noEmit, eslint, and the existing scripts/test-*.ts smoke tests.
Allow npm install and npm run lint when the user asked to install or lint.
block_instructions: Ask before any command that prints, dumps, or copies .env, .env.local, API keys, tokens, or passwords.
Ask before prisma migrate reset, prisma db push --force-reset, DROP DATABASE, or any command that wipes the database.
Ask before git push --force, git reset --hard, or deleting files outside the workspace.
Ask before any LinkedIn login scraping, Indeed login scraping, or RapidAPI/JSearch integration.
Ask before deploying, mutating Vercel/Supabase production settings, or writing to production storage.
